body.name: Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) completed
body.description: A DPIA has been completed for high-risk processing.
body.detail: No formal DPIA is on file, but the design decisions a DPIA would interrogate are documented and defensible.
observations: Data minimisation: only the fields each analysis needs are projected into the graph.
Explainability: every risk score ships its own attribution, so an adverse inference can be contested.
Exculpatory surfacing: the report generator carries evidence that cuts against the hypothesis, not only for it.
A signed DPIA remains the agency's to complete.
